root_idea.summary: The root centers on straightness, balance, and proper proportion between or within things, yielding the ideas of equality, evenness, symmetry, soundness, and a central or equidistant position.
root_idea.development: From this orientation develop the meanings of making something level or well-proportioned, being equal or alike, occupying the middle, becoming upright or settled, and directing oneself toward an intended object.

senses.definition: Be leveled, with the ground made level over or around someone.
senses.usage_conditions: Used here in the passive Quranic construction describing people being buried or reduced to the level of the earth.

senses.definition: Make equal, even, level, or uniform.
senses.usage_conditions: Includes making things equal in relation to one another and making a surface or structure level; the Quranic object may be a person, body, land, heaven, or other created thing.

senses.definition: Fashion, proportion, shape, or complete something in a fitting and harmonious form.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of creation or formation whose parts are made congruent, complete, properly adapted, or soundly ordered.

senses.definition: Make parts uniform or reconstitute them into their proper arrangement.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially relevant to the Quranic discussion of restoring or equalizing the fingers and reconstructing the body's parts.

senses.definition: Make two things level or equal with one another.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with two objects or sides brought to the same level, especially by filling or adjusting the space between them.

senses.definition: Become even, upright, firm, settled, or properly established.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a thing becoming straight, level, steady, or settled in itself; with عَلَى it can describe becoming firmly seated or established upon something, including boarding or sitting securely.

senses.definition: Be equal or alike with another or with others.
senses.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or multiple-subject construction comparing parties, things, or conditions.

senses.definition: Direct oneself or turn toward something.
senses.usage_conditions: With إِلَى, the verb denotes directing oneself, one's will, or one's activity toward an object or destination.

senses.definition: Have ascendancy or established authority over.
senses.usage_conditions: With عَلَى, this is a conventional interpretive construction of ascendancy or mastery; the expression does not by itself prescribe a physical description.
Used of a person attaining mature development in body, strength, or intellect.
Used predicatively, adverbially, or as a noun to say that two things or alternatives are alike, equal, or of equal consequence.

senses.definition: The middle, midst, or central and equidistant position.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of the center of a place, the middle of a route or object, or a position equidistant from two sides.

senses.definition: Equitable, just, right, or properly balanced.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a fair proposition, judgment, arrangement, or course that stands on an equal and just basis.
Describes a person, body, character, path, or condition preserved from excess and deficiency and therefore sound or properly formed.

senses.definition: Even, equidistant, or designated as a common meeting place.
senses.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of a place that is level or midway between points; lexical interpretation also allows a marked or designated place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intend or propose to oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported and disputed attribution for Form I, distinguished from the better-attested use of اِسْتَوَى followed by إِلَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Be equivalent or worth the same in measure, size, quantity, value, quality, knowledge, or ability.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Broader Classical usage of Form III, including equivalence with a thing or competition with an equal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Be like another in physical make, symmetry, or proportion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Form IV usage, especially of likeness between a parent and offspring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Have sexual intercourse, with complete penetration.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Classical construction with فِي followed by the sexual object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Become base, abject, vile, or ignominious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV usage treated as related to السَّوْأَة or evil.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Void one's ordure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily-function usage connected in the lexical discussion with السَّوْأَة, the anus.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Drop, omit, leave out, or neglect something inadvertently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported of omitting a letter, word, or verse, including in recitation or written transmission of the Quran, and also of omissions in reckoning or shooting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Become affected with leprosy or a similar evil bodily condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage associated in the lexical discussion with السُّوء as an evil affection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Recover from illness or become free of a disease.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A privative or remedial Form IV usage in the same lexical family as the preceding bodily-condition sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Become equal or alike with one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VI, especially with two or more participants equal in a matter, property, or condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A like, equal, or counterpart; in لَا سِيَّمَا, especially or above all.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression لَا سِيَّمَا is an exceptive or emphatic construction meaning that what follows is distinguished from or has no like among what precedes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state or abundance of wealth, welfare, or prosperity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in idioms describing what has risen to or covered one's head, figuratively meaning accumulated prosperity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A smooth, even desert or open tract.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The terrain is so called because its routes and surface are uniform.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Other than, instead of, or in place of.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as an epithet or exceptive/locative adverb, often governing a following noun and corresponding to غَيْر.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The departure or loss of one's intellect or judgment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiom عَقْلُكَ سِوَاكَ, literally that one's intellect has gone away from him.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The direction or destination toward which one tends.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare use in which سِوَى means the direction or intended object of one's movement or attention.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The summit or upper central part of a mountain, hill, or stony elevation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized topographical extension from the idea of a central or prominent level.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Complete or whole.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally or adverbially of something whose measure or make is complete; this Classical interpretation is kept separate from the Quranic equality and middle senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lunar night when the moon's illumination is even, traditionally the thirteenth or fourteenth night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A calendrical expression, with variation among authorities concerning the exact night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A simple pack vehicle or padded covering placed on the back of a camel, ass, or similar animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Associated especially with the conveyance of female slaves or people of limited means; also called حَوِيَّة in one form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A changeable condition that alternates between straightness and crookedness, gathering and separation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proverbial expression applied to a person or situation that does not remain in one state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land whose surface or soil resembles sand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of terrain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A prepared speech, especially a deceptive or harmful speech contrived against someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression ضَرَبَ لِي سَايَةَ, with disagreement over its derivation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most even, uniform, or equitable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative adjective applied to places or arrangements.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An even or level place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare noun with an augmentative ت.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Being in a good, sound, or right condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in a greeting formula about the welfare of one's children and livestock; the transmitted form is distinguished from the related participle مُسْتَوٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Be covered by the earth, perish in the earth, or be buried.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the earth or over a buried person to describe the ground becoming level with or over him.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Become uniformly barren or drought-stricken.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of land whose surface becomes uniformly affected by drought or barrenness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Become symmetrical, congruous, complete, or properly adjusted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quasi-passive or intransitive Classical development describing a thing as having acquired suitable and consistent form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Become thoroughly cooked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of food reaching a fully cooked state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The equinoctial line or state of equal day and night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Preserved as the technical noun خط الاستواء, the equinoctial line.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rectify, adjust, or put an affair into a right or good state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical use of Form II applied to an affair, plan, or condition rather than to a physical object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Frame or devise a stratagem or plot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized figurative use describing the deliberate construction of a scheme.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cook food thoroughly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The transitive Form II counterpart of food becoming fully cooked.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Be altered or changed for the worse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported passive or quasi-passive form, with the transmitted vocalization noted as uncertain.

cautions: The QAC Form I group is retained as authoritative for form accounting, although its Quranic surface تُسَوَّىٰ and the lexical explanation cited for it correspond closely to the passive leveling construction discussed under Form II.

The Form VIII construction اِسْتَوَى عَلَى has several reported interpretive renderings, including becoming established and having ascendancy or mastery; the entry records the lexical construction without imposing a physical interpretation.

Several Lane Quran references use historical citation conventions that do not align mechanically with modern verse numbering; Quran example locations here are taken only from the supplied QAC locations.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: Lane's phrase السِّوَاءُ وَاللِّوَاءُ is translated as seeking or demanding aid, but Lane expressly states that the independent lexical meaning of السِّوَاء in that phrase is not explained, so it is not assigned a dictionary sense.
